suites.title: Speech recognition on Apple devices · Earnings22
suites.description: Argmax WhisperKit. Latest published run for each device, checkpoint and ten-minute speech set. Speed is audio seconds processed per wall-clock second. Word error is measured on that same set.

suites.title: Core ML image generation
suites.description: Apple and Hugging Face. Median end-to-end latency for 20 denoising steps. SD 2.1 uses six-bit weights, mobile SDXL uses mixed-bit weights, and Mac SDXL uses FP16.

suites.title: Speech implementation comparison
suites.description: 13-minute recording, beam size 5. GPU tests use CUDA 12.4. CPU tests use eight threads. Memory is the implementation’s reported RAM or VRAM usage in MB.

suites.title: Speech synthesis on Mac
suites.description: FluidAudio historical MiniMax corpus, 100 phrases per language. First audio is the first 80 ms frame for PocketTTS and the complete waveform for one-shot models. Elapsed time is warm median synthesis. Peak is process RSS; the CLI divides bytes by 1024².

suites.title: Embedding throughput and retrieval quality
suites.description: Hugging Face measured query embeddings per second on GooAQ using the best tested batch size per model. NanoBEIR NDCG@10 is a separate quality evaluation and uses a 0–1 scale. Unmeasured 7B entries and the lexical BM25 baseline are omitted.
